name: Captain Coinsworth
bio: Leads the auto-battling party in Idle Delve. Works hard even while you sleep.

portrait.subject: a cute chubby little adventurer captain with a feathered cap, a bulging coin pouch, a small sword and a confident grin

request: Captain Coinsworth of Idle Delve! My party works while you rest. Be our patron? 💰
hello: Splendid! We'll keep digging. You keep checking in!
Gold doesn't spend itself. That's your job.
about: I'm Coinsworth. My party delves the dungeon day and night, collecting gold for town. You spend it. Teamwork!
how: Your party auto-battles down the dungeon, even while you're away. Bank their gold in Town on recruits, training and deeper starting floors.
tips: Train stats before hiring more heroes.
Buying a deeper starting floor saves loads of time.
Check in often to bank gold!
chat: The party found a chest. Inside: another chest. Inside that: gold!
Our cleric healed a rat. The rat joined us.
We hit floor fifty. I gave a speech.
Our warrior asked for a raise. Paid him in hugs.
nudge: Gold's piling up! Come spend it?
The party wants new recruits. Visit town!
idle: The party kept delving for {ago}. There's gold waiting for you! 💰
{ago} of delving! Your vault is bursting!
{game} has some gold waiting for you! The party's been busy for {ago}.
progress: We've got {gold} gold banked! Upgrades await!
Deepest floor so far: {floor}. Next stop, {floor+1}!

questions.q: What should we spend our gold on?

update: Idle Delve news: v{version} is live! More to find!
